leah (devex): Hey team — hitting a frustrating mix of telemetry issues in the Python sample app used for onboarding: too-verbose logs (DEBUG by default), user IDs appearing in plain text, and the Go SDK sample doesn't propagate x-request-id / trace headers consistently. Anyone run into this?

emma (sdk): Ugh. We accidentally left DEBUG as the default in the example env. That explains the noise. Do you have a paste of the log lines with user_id?

leah (devex): Yep. Snippet from local run:

```
# INFO 2026-02-12T14:12:03Z request_id=abc123 user_id=43 email=jane@example.com model=redwood-1 tokens=12
# DEBUG 2026-02-12T14:12:03Z auth_token=eyJhbGciOi... (truncated)
```

leah (devex): Also saw these headers not making it through the Go client to the backend: `x-request-id` and `traceparent` — traces show new root spans created on retry attempts instead of attaching to original span.

raj (sre): The retry root-span duplication normally means our OpenTelemetry propagation isn't wired into the HTTP retry wrapper. Go client's http retry lib spins a new context sometimes. What version of the Go SDK is the sample using?

leah (devex): sample-app-go uses `redwood-go-sdk v0.6.2` (the quickstart).

marcos (eng-ml): There's a known compat issue fixed in v0.6.4 where the Go SDK reuses a request without copying the context. But the bigger concern is redaction: logs include `user_id` and `email`. We should not show PII in any example by default.

emma (sdk): Agreed. Proposed quick fixes:
- Set LOG_LEVEL to `info` in the quickstart env and docs.
- Enable a default redaction sanitizer in the SDK dev profile that strips fields in `REDACT_FIELDS` (user_id, email, auth_token).
- Add an explicit note in the Go sample to install OTEL propagators and wrap the retryer so context is preserved.

raj (sre): For the OTEL propagator, the Go sample should call something like:
```
// set W3C trace context
prop := otelpropagation.TraceContext{}
otel.SetTextMapPropagator(prop)
```
and ensure the HTTP client uses `req = req.WithContext(ctx)` before retries. Otherwise each retry starts without trace headers.

leah (devex): Nice. Also the JS/Python samples use our telemetry hook automagically but Go was left manual. Should we add an opinionated small wrapper in the repo: `redwood/telemetry/wrappers` that auto-applies propagators + sanitizer for quickstarts?

marcos (eng-ml): Yep — small wrapper that sets: `LOG_LEVEL=info`, `REDACT_FIELDS=user_id,email,ssn,auth_token`, installs OTEL instrumentation for http and grpc, and exports a single `StartTelemetry()` function. That reduces onboarding friction.

emma (sdk): I'll open two PRs: one for changing default quickstart envs + docs, and one to add the sanitizer lib. I'll also bump the Go sample to v0.6.4 and add the `req.WithContext` note.

leah (devex): Thanks. For trace parity, can someone add a small e2e test that fires a request and forces a retry (simulate 500) and asserts the server sees the same `x-request-id` across attempts? Helps avoid regressions.

raj (sre): I'll add that to the infra tests. Suggestion: test flow should assert that `traceparent` or `x-request-id` is identical for attempts tied to same logical operation. If not, fail.

ci-bot: CI checklist created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/issue/492 — includes: update quickstarts, add sanitizer, bump Go SDK, add e2e retry-propagation test. :white_check_mark:

leah (devex): Perfect. One more tiny UX ask — make the sanitizer also obfuscate tokens in stack traces printed by debug logs (replace token middle with `***`). We'll want that even when debug is enabled locally.

emma (sdk): Good call. I'll include a small regex-based sanitizer that runs on `logger` output in the dev profile.

marcos (eng-ml): FWIW putting too much magic into the wrapper can hide issues for prod users. Let's keep the wrapper opt-in in code but on by default in quickstart configs. Docs will show how to opt out.

leah (devex): Agreed. Thanks all — assigning myself to update the quickstart templates once PRs merge. :thumbsup:

emma (sdk): PRs opened: #125 (quickstart envs/docs), #126 (sanitizer lib), #127 (go sample bump + context fix).

raj (sre): I'll pick up the e2e test after #127 merges.

leah (devex): Closing loop — can someone add a tiny blurb in the onboarding checklist about verifying `x-request-id` propagation and that logs are redacted before hitting shared examples? Saves new hires time.

marcos (eng-ml): On it.

leah (devex): Thanks y'all. :sparkles:
